play as the hero's shade, with customizable options.

put heros_shade.dusk in dusklight's mods folder. the options are in the mods window, under hero's shade.
needs dusklight 2.0.2.

only windows has been played. mac, linux, android and ios are built here but untested.

- his armour and ghostly body over link, in every outfit or just the ones you pick
- his golden wolf for the wolf
- his sword and shield over any of link's swords and shields
- silent, like him
